info.title: Create Responsible Person
info.description:
Add a new EU responsible person who ensures a seller's products comply with EU regulations. The provided information will be automatically translated into all EU languages supported by TikTok Shop.

* Use the [Search Responsible Persons API](67066a55f17b7d02f95d2fb1) to obtain the translations.
* Use the [Partial Edit Responsible Person API](67066a5587019802fdce19b3) to edit the translations, if necessary.
* When creating a product, pass the returned `responsible_person_id` to associate the product with the responsible person.

Target seller: Local sellers operating in EU countries

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

name.description:
The responsible person name.
Max length: 200 characters

email.description: The email address of the responsible person.

country_code.description:
The country code of the phone number, prefixed by a plus `+` symbol. E.g. +353 for Ireland. Only EU country codes are allowed.
Max digits: 4

phone_number.description: The phone number of the responsible person.

street_address_line1.description:
The detailed street address of the location, including the building number, street name, district, city, province, and any relevant details.
Max length: 500 characters

street_address_line2.description:
(**Deprecated**: This field is deprecated and will be removed in a future API version. If provided, its value will be merged into `street_address_line1`. It is recommended to specify `street_address_line1` directly.)
An optional secondary line for additional address details, if necessary.
Max length: 500 characters

district.description:
(**Deprecated**: This field is deprecated and will be removed in a future API version. If provided, its value will be merged into `street_address_line1`. It is recommended to specify `street_address_line1` directly.)

The district name.
Max length: 500 characters

city.description:
(**Deprecated**: This field is deprecated and will be removed in a future API version. If provided, its value will be merged into `street_address_line1`. It is recommended to specify `street_address_line1` directly.)

The city name.
Max length: 500 characters

postal_code.description:
The postal code.
Max length: 500 characters

province.description:
(**Deprecated**: This field is deprecated and will be removed in a future API version. If provided, its value will be merged into `street_address_line1`. It is recommended to specify `street_address_line1` directly.)

The province, state, or region name.
Max length: 500 characters

country.description: The two letter ISO 3166 country code representing the country of the address. It must be an EU country.

address.description: The residential address of the responsible person.

locale.description:
The BCP-47 locale code representing the language used for specifying the responsible person information.
Possible values:
- de-DE
- en-IE
- es-ES
- fr-FR
- it-IT
Default: The locale of the seller's registered business address.

**Note**: The information provided will be automatically translated into all EU languages supported by TikTok Shop. Ensure the locale matches the language used in field values to avoid inaccurate translations.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

responsible_person_id.description: A unique ID that identifies the responsible person in TikTok Shop.
